method: Visual review of every labelled actual-PTS frame at 4.8-second intervals across the full clip, then 71 actual-PTS 1-second frames around exercise pickup, curl and edit transitions, plus two 960px equipment/grip frames. No installed local ASR engine; no transcript or paid model used.

observations: Gym presenter and branding; not a demonstrated curl.
First presenter talks and shows empty-hand grip gestures. No bar curl credited.
Performer bends toward angled bar, holds it with two hands, stands with bar low; close view reveals angled shaft and underhand hand contact.
Bar moves near torso and back low, with corresponding visible elbow bend changes. Head and feet outside close crop.
Wider, closer and later wider views show raised and low bar positions. Framing changes limit continuity and repetition counts.
Second presenter talks and gestures; not credited as completed curl evidence.
Second performer bends to straight bar, picks it up with two hands, and stands with the bar low.
Visible straight-bar raises toward torso and returns low. Camera shifts to a closer side view. No exact load, tempo or repetition count measured.
Performer bends and lowers bar out of main crop. Final floor contact/release not confirmed.
Speaker talks/gestures after the exercise; these explanations are not measured outcome evidence.
Website/subscription cards, unrelated inset exercise footage and animated logos. Excluded from main exercise criteria.

limits: All intervals are approximate visual anchors, not prescribed durations.
Native video resolution is 1920×1080; review sheets are downscaled. Two native aspect close views used to distinguish bar shape and hand contact.
The source contains edits, camera reframing, blur and body/equipment crops.
Audio retained but untranscribed; source explanations are separate from measured visual evidence.
No plate weight, joint angle, force, muscle recruitment, repetition target, pain/comfort, clinical suitability or safety certification inferred.
No original-source verification beyond Commons metadata and official derivative source; original endpoint remained rate limited.
criteria_initial_state: All unknown; no fixture success claimed.
